verses.literal: I am a rose of Sharon a lily of the valley

verses.original: כְּשֽׁוֹשַׁנָּה֙ בֵּ֣ין הַחוֹחִ֔ים כֵּ֥ן רַעְיָתִ֖י בֵּ֥ין הַבָּנֽוֹת׃
verses.transliteration: kə·šō·wō·šan·nāh bên ha·ḥō·w·ḥîm kên ra‘·yā·ṯî bên hab·bā·nō·wṯ
verses.literal: Like a lily among the thorns - is my darling among the maidens

verses.original: כְּתַפּ֙וּחַ֙ בַּעֲצֵ֣י הַיַּ֔עַר כֵּ֥ן דּוֹדִ֖י בֵּ֣ין הַבָּנִ֑ים חִמַּ֣דְתִּי וְיָשַׁ֔בְתִּי בְּצִלּוֹ֙ וּפִרְי֖וֹ מָת֥וֹק לְחִכִּֽי׃
verses.transliteration: kə·ṯap·pū·aḥ ba·‘ă·ṣê hay·ya·‘ar kên dō·w·ḏî bên hab·bā·nîm ḥim·maḏ·tî wə·yā·šaḇ·tî bə·ṣil·lōw ū·p̄ir·yōw mā·ṯō·wq lə·ḥik·kî
verses.literal: Like an apple tree among the trees of the forest - is my beloved among the young men I delight to sit in his shade and his fruit is sweet to my taste

verses.original: הֱבִיאַ֙נִי֙ אֶל־ בֵּ֣ית הַיָּ֔יִן וְדִגְל֥וֹ עָלַ֖י אַהֲבָֽה׃
verses.literal: He has brought me to the house of wine and his banner over me [is] love

verses.original: סַמְּכ֙וּנִי֙ בָּֽאֲשִׁישׁ֔וֹת רַפְּד֖וּנִי בַּתַּפּוּחִ֑ים כִּי־ אָֽנִי׃ חוֹלַ֥ת אַהֲבָ֖ה
verses.transliteration: sam·mə·ḵū·nî bā·’ă·šî·šō·wṯ rap·pə·ḏū·nî bat·tap·pū·ḥîm kî- ’ā·nî ḥō·w·laṯ ’a·hă·ḇāh
verses.literal: Sustain me with raisins refresh me with apples for I am faint with love
His left hand is under my head and his right arm embraces me

verses.original: בְּנ֤וֹת יְרוּשָׁלִַ֙ם֙ הִשְׁבַּ֨עְתִּי אֶתְכֶ֜ם בִּצְבָא֔וֹת א֖וֹ בְּאַיְל֣וֹת הַשָּׂדֶ֑ה אִם־ תָּעִ֧ירוּ׀ וְֽאִם־ תְּעֽוֹרְר֛וּ אֶת־ הָאַהֲבָ֖ה עַ֥ד שֶׁתֶּחְפָּֽץ׃ס
verses.transliteration: bə·nō·wṯ yə·rū·šā·lim hiš·ba‘·tî ’eṯ·ḵem biṣ·ḇā·’ō·wṯ ’ōw bə·’ay·lō·wṯ haś·śā·ḏeh ’im- tā·‘î·rū wə·’im- tə·‘ō·wr·rū ’eṯ- hā·’a·hă·ḇāh ‘aḏ šet·teḥ·pāṣ
verses.literal: O daughters of Jerusalem I adjure you by the gazelles and does of the field Do not arouse or awaken - love until the time is right

verses.original: ק֣וֹל דּוֹדִ֔י הִנֵּה־ זֶ֖ה בָּ֑א מְדַלֵּג֙ עַל־ הֶ֣הָרִ֔ים מְקַפֵּ֖ץ עַל־ הַגְּבָעֽוֹת׃
verses.transliteration: qō·wl dō·w·ḏî hin·nêh- zeh bā mə·ḏal·lêḡ ‘al- he·hā·rîm mə·qap·pêṣ ‘al- hag·gə·ḇā·‘ō·wṯ
verses.literal: Listen My beloved [approaches] Look Here he comes leaping across the mountains bounding over the hills

verses.original: דוֹדִי֙ דּוֹמֶ֤ה לִצְבִ֔י א֖וֹ לְעֹ֣פֶר הָֽאַיָּלִ֑ים הִנֵּה־ זֶ֤ה עוֹמֵד֙ אַחַ֣ר כָּתְלֵ֔נוּ מַשְׁגִּ֙יחַ֙ מִן־ הַֽחֲלֹּנ֔וֹת מֵצִ֖יץ מִן־ הַֽחֲרַכִּֽים׃
verses.transliteration: ḏō·w·ḏî dō·w·meh liṣ·ḇî ’ōw lə·‘ō·p̄er hā·’ay·yā·lîm hin·nêh- zeh ‘ō·w·mêḏ ’a·ḥar kā·ṯə·lê·nū maš·gî·aḥ min- ha·ḥăl·lō·nō·wṯ mê·ṣîṣ min- ha·ḥă·rak·kîm
verses.literal: My beloved is like a gazelle or a young stag Look he stands behind our wall gazing through the windows peering through the lattice

verses.original: דוֹדִ֖י עָנָ֥ה וְאָ֣מַר לִ֑י ק֥וּמִי לָ֛ךְ רַעְיָתִ֥י וּלְכִי־ לָֽךְ׃ יָפָתִ֖י
verses.transliteration: ḏō·w·ḏî ‘ā·nāh wə·’ā·mar lî qū·mî lāḵ ra‘·yā·ṯî ū·lə·ḵî- lāḵ yā·p̄ā·ṯî
verses.literal: My beloved calls to me Arise my darling Come away with me my beautiful one

verses.original: כִּֽי־ הִנֵּ֥ה הַסְּתָו עָבָ֑ר הַגֶּ֕שֶׁם חָלַ֖ף הָלַ֥ךְ לֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: kî- hin·nêh has·sə·ṯå̄w ‘ā·ḇār hag·ge·šem ḥā·lap̄ hā·laḵ lōw
verses.literal: For now the winter is past the rain is over and gone

verses.original: הַנִּצָּנִים֙ נִרְא֣וּ בָאָ֔רֶץ עֵ֥ת הַזָּמִ֖יר הִגִּ֑יעַ וְק֥וֹל הַתּ֖וֹר נִשְׁמַ֥ע בְּאַרְצֵֽנוּ׃
verses.transliteration: han·niṣ·ṣā·nîm nir·’ū ḇā·’ā·reṣ ‘êṯ haz·zā·mîr hig·gî·a‘ wə·qō·wl hat·tō·wr niš·ma‘ bə·’ar·ṣê·nū
verses.literal: The flowers have appeared in the countryside the season of singing has come and the cooing of turtledoves is heard in our land

verses.original: הַתְּאֵנָה֙ חָֽנְטָ֣ה פַגֶּ֔יהָ סְמָדַ֖ר וְהַגְּפָנִ֥ים׀ נָ֣תְנוּ רֵ֑יחַ ק֥וּמִי לְכִי רַעְיָתִ֥י וּלְכִי־ לָֽךְ׃ס יָפָתִ֖י
verses.transliteration: hat·tə·’ê·nāh ḥā·nə·ṭāh p̄ag·ge·hā sə·mā·ḏar wə·hag·gə·p̄ā·nîm nā·ṯə·nū rê·aḥ qū·mî lə·ḵī ra‘·yā·ṯî ū·lə·ḵî- lāḵ yā·p̄ā·ṯî
verses.literal: The fig tree ripens its figs the blossoming vines spread their fragrance Arise come away my darling come away with me my beautiful one

verses.original: יוֹנָתִ֞י בְּחַגְוֵ֣י הַסֶּ֗לַע בְּסֵ֙תֶר֙ הַמַּדְרֵגָ֔ה הַרְאִ֙ינִי֙ אֶתּ־ מַרְאַ֔יִךְ הַשְׁמִיעִ֖ינִי אֶת־ קוֹלֵ֑ךְ כִּי־ קוֹלֵ֥ךְ עָרֵ֖ב וּמַרְאֵ֥יךְ נָאוֶֽה׃ס
verses.transliteration: yō·w·nā·ṯî bə·ḥaḡ·wê has·se·la‘ bə·sê·ṯer ham·maḏ·rê·ḡāh har·’î·nî ’eṯ- mar·ʾa·yiḵ haš·mî·‘î·nî ’eṯ- qō·w·lêḵ kî- qō·w·lêḵ ‘ā·rêḇ ū·mar·’êḵ nā·weh
verses.literal: O my dove in the clefts of the rock in the crevices of the cliff let me see - your face let me hear - your voice for your voice is sweet and your countenance is lovely

verses.original: אֶֽחֱזוּ־ לָ֙נוּ֙ שֽׁוּעָלִ֔ים קְטַנִּ֖ים שֽׁוּעָלִ֥ים מְחַבְּלִ֣ים כְּרָמִ֑ים וּכְרָמֵ֖ינוּ סְמָדַֽר׃
verses.transliteration: ’e·ḥĕ·zū- lā·nū šū·‘ā·lîm qə·ṭan·nîm šū·‘ā·lîm mə·ḥab·bə·lîm kə·rā·mîm ū·ḵə·rā·mê·nū sə·mā·ḏar
verses.literal: Catch for us the foxes the little foxes that ruin the vineyards for our vineyards are in bloom

verses.original: דּוֹדִ֥י לִי֙ וַאֲנִ֣י ל֔וֹ הָרֹעֶ֖ה בַּשּׁוֹשַׁנִּֽים׃
verses.transliteration: dō·w·ḏî lî wa·’ă·nî lōw hā·rō·‘eh baš·šō·wō·šan·nîm
verses.literal: My beloved is mine and I am his he pastures [his flock] among the lilies

verses.original: עַ֤ד הַיּ֔וֹם שֶׁיָּפ֙וּחַ֙ הַצְּלָלִ֑ים וְנָ֖סוּ סֹב֩ דוֹדִ֜י דְּמֵה־ לְךָ֨ לִצְבִ֗י א֛וֹ לְעֹ֥פֶר הָאַיָּלִ֖ים עַל־ הָ֥רֵי בָֽתֶר׃ס
verses.transliteration: ‘aḏ hay·yō·wm še·yā·p̄ū·aḥ haṣ·ṣə·lā·lîm wə·nā·sū sōḇ ḏō·w·ḏî də·mêh- lə·ḵā liṣ·ḇî ’ōw lə·‘ō·p̄er hā·’ay·yā·lîm ‘al- hā·rê ḇā·ṯer
verses.literal: Before the day breaks and shadows flee turn my beloved and be like a gazelle or a young stag . . . on the mountains of Bether
